name: Larva
summary: A worker abstraction awaiting an admitted task and compatible loadout.

behavior.target: Bind one work identity, scope, lease, carrier and result contract before launch.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: Larva. Show a compact modular seed-engine with visible attachment points. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for Larva; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: turn an admitted work packet into one bounded worker attempt with a reviewable result.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: When preparing a worker for a specific task; recover its admitted ABI before launch.
inputs: WorkItem identity, scope, lease, effect ceiling and budget
Exact input artifacts, admitted ABI reference, compatible loadout and result contract
procedure: Map supplied inputs and required outputs to the recovered ABI without inventing fields.
Resolve the carrier and loadout against the task's requirements.
Prepare an attempt packet; identify missing bindings before execution.
For an authorized attempt, perform the bounded step and return its candidate artifact plus remaining work.
outputs: Candidate artifact or explicit missing-binding report
failure_modes: Starting from a role name alone
Expanding scope to keep a worker busy

example.situation: A WorkItem requests extraction of three supplied document fields.
example.action: Bind those inputs, extract only the requested fields, and attach source locations.
example.evidence: Expected: the output table, input revisions and an independent field check.

neurosymbolic.neural: Interpret the task and transform its inputs.
neurosymbolic.symbolic: Constrain the attempt through its ABI, scope and result contract.

frozen: Work identity, admitted ABI and effect ceiling
evolution.fitness: Evaluate correct bounded outputs, resource use and handoff completeness against the fixed task rubric.
